heading: top-center
name: 置中標題組＋置中單欄表單＋區塊下緣分隔線
desc: 上方置中的標題組，下方是置中的單欄表單：每個輸入欄位的名稱在上、輸入框在下，最後是置中的勾選同意段落與送出按鈕；下方留白較大，區塊下緣有一條橫跨畫面的分隔線。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放副標，沒有時省略；標題明顯大於副標。標題組下方是一個表單，置中，約佔畫面寬的三分之二。數個輸入欄位單欄直向排列，每個欄位上方是小字的欄位名稱、下方是橫跨表單寬度的輸入框，欄位名稱與輸入框靠左；最後可有一個較高的多行輸入框。輸入欄位下方可放一組置中的次要文字，包含一個勾選框與一行含文字連結的次要文字，沒有時省略；最下方是置中的送出按鈕，明顯大於一般按鈕。區塊下方的留白明顯大於上方，約四分之一個畫面高；區塊最下緣有一條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線。
mobile: 結構不變，等比縮放：標題組仍在上方置中；表單改為對齊頁面內容寬度，輸入欄位仍單欄直向排列、欄位名稱在上、輸入框在下；勾選框段落與送出按鈕仍置中；區塊下方仍留較大的空白，下緣的分隔線仍橫跨畫面寬。

en.name: Centered heading group + centered single-column form + bottom-edge divider
en.desc: A centered heading group above a centered single-column form: each input field has its name above and its input box below, followed by a centered consent checkbox group and submit button; generous space below, with a divider spanning the screen at the section's bottom edge.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a subheading below; omit it when there is no content. The title is noticeably larger than the subheading. Below the heading group is a form, centered and taking about two thirds of the screen width. Several input fields are stacked vertically in a single column; each field has a small field name above and an input box spanning the form width below, with the field name and input box aligned left; the last one may be a taller multi-line input. Below the input fields, optionally place a centered group of secondary text containing a checkbox and a line of secondary text with a text link; omit it when there is no content. At the very bottom is a centered submit button, noticeably larger than a regular button. The space below the section is noticeably larger than above, about a quarter of a viewport tall; a divider spanning the screen width runs along the very bottom edge of the section.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The structure stays the same and scales proportionally: the heading group stays at the top, centered; the form aligns to the page content width, the input fields remain stacked in a single column with the field name above and the input box below; the checkbox group and submit button stay centered; the section still keeps generous space below, and the divider at the bottom edge still spans the screen width.
